continuity_scope: Jujutsu Kaisen, Vol. 1, VIZ English digital edition (Shonen Jump imprint; 191 pages; eISBN 978-1-9747-1568-8; released 2019-12-03). This is a narrow publisher-metadata pass for that manga volume only. It excludes the Japanese edition as an independent continuity witness, anime, films, games, novels, guidebooks, later volumes, and adaptations.

work_or_witnesses.edition: Shueisha Japanese Volume 1 bibliographic and chapter-list record, corroborative only

coverage_rule: Include only individual dramatic characters directly named and described in the selected VIZ Volume 1 metadata. VIZ names Yuji Itadori and Ryomen Sukuna; both are recorded. It does not provide an accessible claim-specific cast list adequate for additional named-character records or relationships.
omissions: All other Volume 1 people, including Yuji's unnamed friend and unnamed club members, whose names or claim-specific descriptions are not supplied by the selected VIZ metadata.
Jujutsu sorcerers, cursed spirits, clubs, school, curses, techniques, items, places, and themes as character nodes.
Anime, film, games, novels, guidebooks, later manga, the Japanese edition, and other adaptations.
content_cautions: VIZ rates Volume 1 Teen Plus and describes a teenager swallowing part of a demon to save a friend, supernatural predation on humans, a sealed cursed object, and threatened catastrophic harm. This pass does not reproduce scenes or catalogue violence, death, body horror, or child peril beyond that publisher framing.

Terms such as cursed, demon, jujutsu, occult, and sorcerer are recorded only as fictional source terminology. They are not claims about any living religious tradition, spiritual practice, or real-world occult belief.
The synopsis describes Yuji as a teenager but does not establish a clinical, disability, illness, or mental-health framework; none is inferred.
uncertainties: No accessible VIZ chapter-level primary manga locator was available for the selected Volume 1 product. The Shueisha record supplies a chapter list for the original Japanese volume but is not used to import translation or adaptation-specific claims.
VIZ's accessible product page credits Gege Akutami for story and art but does not identify an individual English translator; none is inferred.

The selected metadata does not establish named friend/club-member identities, detailed techniques or cursed-energy mechanics, formal school enrollment, later body-sharing details, deaths, or a full character cast.
Anime, game, film, novel, and other adaptation continuities are separate and unreviewed.
evidence_basis: VIZ's official English Volume 1 product pages supply all character, premise, and bibliographic claims. Shueisha's official Japanese Volume 1 page is used only as a corroborative original-manga bibliographic/chapter locator. No fan wiki or Wikipedia was used.
